nodes.name: Nightly 02:17
nodes.notes: 02:17 rather than 02:00 on purpose — everyone's cron lands on the hour, including Anthropic's other callers.

parameters.query:
SELECT transcript
  FROM agent_runs
 WHERE started_at > now() - interval '7 days'
   AND transcript IS NOT NULL
 ORDER BY started_at DESC
 LIMIT 300

nodes.name: Fetch Recent Transcripts
nodes.notes: LIMIT 300 keeps the prompt bounded. Raise it once you know your real volume and token cost.

nodes.name: Cluster via Claude
nodes.notes: One call for the whole batch, not one per transcript — that is what keeps this a rounding error on cost. output_config.format guarantees parseable JSON, so no retry-on-parse loop is needed.

parameters.query:
INSERT INTO faq_summary (question, frequency, last_seen_at)
VALUES ($1, $2, now())
ON CONFLICT (question)
DO UPDATE SET frequency    = faq_summary.frequency + EXCLUDED.frequency,
              last_seen_at = now()

nodes.name: Upsert faq_summary
